sourceTitle: The Wreck of the Golden Mary
description: "The Wreck of the Golden Mary" by Charles Dickens is a novella written during the Victorian era, likely in the mid-19th century. This maritime narrative combines elements of adventure and human resilience, focusing on the harrowing experiences of the crew and passengers aboard the ill-fated ship, the Golden Mary.
